Manage VM creation configs.

```text
pomme config SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme config init

Create a VM config interactively.

```text
pomme config init [--format FORMAT] [--output OUTPUT] [--force]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--format FORMAT` | Config format: json, yaml, toml, or pkl. Values: `json`, `yaml`, `toml`, `pkl`. Default: `yaml`. |
| `--output OUTPUT` | Output file path. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Replace an existing output file. |

## pomme config validate

Validate a create config without resolving versions.

```text
pomme config validate PATH [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PATH` | Path to a config file with a `.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.toml`, or `.pkl` extension. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme config render

Resolve a config's versions and print the creation plan.

```text
pomme config render PATH [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PATH` | Path to a config file with a `.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.toml`, or `.pkl` extension. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
